benefits.name: Higher Education Sponsorship
benefits.details: Self-development for the employees is a Key focus area, here at Coforge. Though this partnership scheme, Coforge provides its employees financial support for upskilling though higher education.

benefits.name: Company Paid Mediclaim, AD&D and life
benefits.details: Employee and dependent care and wellness is an important part of the company offering where company provides the benefits through various schemes. Employee does have a choice for making voluntary additional coverages for extended coverage

benefits.name: Flexible choice of pay components
benefits.details: Coforge offers all employees with a flexi basket to choose per their individual needs the components of the pay structure within the guidelines of applicable laws. These components, while serving specific needs for employees also helps to optimize the taxes
